rooms.name: Pavlova Suites
rooms.lede: Modern yet full of charm, each individually curated suite is a vibrant mix of local artistry, reclaimed treasures, and handmade touches. Designed with an open, airy feel, these 40 sq m (430 sq ft) spaces offer a stylish bohemian retreat, perfect for those spending their days exploring Puerto Viejo or unwinding by the beach.

rooms.name: 2-Bedroom Luxury Bungalow
rooms.lede: Perfect for couples traveling together or families craving space, these 76 sq.m (820 sq.ft) bungalows blend Caribbean charm with eclectic design. Enjoy a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience, where privacy, relaxation, and inspiration come naturally in this vibrant Puerto Viejo retreat.

rooms.name: 2-Bedroom Deluxe Bungalow
facts: 1 King + 2 Singles (convertible to King), 2 en-suite bathrooms
rooms.lede: Here, luxury meets a touch of whimsy. The 2-Bedroom Deluxe Bungalows draw inspiration from traditional Caribbean houses, creating a uniquely enchanting experience.

rooms.name: 1-Bedroom Bungalow
rooms.lede: Designed for privacy and space, these 50 sq.m (540 sq.ft) bungalows offer a Caribbean-chic escape nestled in lush gardens. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living, private verandas, and open-air wellness therapies in your own serene hideaway.

rooms.name: Premier Villa

rooms.name: Deluxe Bungalow

rooms.name: Arenal Pool Casita
facts: 1 King Bed or 2 Twin Beds + Day Bed
rooms.lede: Luxurious 97 m² freestanding casita featuring a private plunge pool, expansive garden terrace, indoor and outdoor rain showers, and serene rainforest surroundings, ideal for romantic escapes or small families.

rooms.name: Rainforest Pool Villa

rooms.name: Private Residences
facts: 2 King Beds + 4 Queen Beds (2-bedroom residence setup; multiple tents/rooms)
rooms.lede: Expansive rainforest private residence composed of two family tent suites with additional sleeping areas, featuring a fully equipped villa, indoor and outdoor living spaces, fire pit, and an oversized hot spring infinity pool. Ideal for large families or groups, with panoramic views of the Arenal Volcano.

Set in the Costa Rican rainforest with stunning Arenal Volcano views, it offers the perfect blend of nature, comfort, and privacy.
